title: Emergency Contact Update Form
subtitle: Capture contact priority, relationship, phone route, and release authority; confirm effective date and prior record supersession.
description: Emergency Contact Update records contact priority, relationship, phone route, release authority, effective date, and prior record supersession. Emergency Contact Update evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this emergency contact update operational record when staff must document contact priority and relationship. Reconcile phone route, release authority, effective date, and prior record supersession before the emergency contact update handoff. Use identity-verification evidence, the prior contact snapshot, custody or release restriction reference, confirmation message, effective-date audit, and supersession log. Ask the assigned emergency contact update reviewer to confirm contact priority against the organization's policy.

sections.guidance: Preserve contact priority, relationship, phone and alternate route, release authority, effective date, identity verification, and superseded-record handling.
